title: Sunbreak Strut
description: A sunny, bass-driven dance-pop groove that struts out of the gate with a funky CasioRZ1 kit and warm jvbass lines. The track peaks early with shimmering synth chords and bright arpy melody, then playfully deconstructs — peeling back layers, widening the stereo space, and letting the bass carry you home.
